items.text: Browns placed RB Dylan Sampson on injured reserve (knee) and signed Jaleel McLaughlin from practice squad.
items.why: Knee injury from W1, significant time

items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has legit chance to return Week 2 or 3 per reports, but same knee as prior PCL/bone bruise. Scary history. Coach day-to-day.
items.why: Meniscus trim; team optimistic for quick return
items.implication: Monitor practice; TE1 if active, Mayer if out

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey rib injury, day-to-day per HC Harbaugh. Team wants to see how he feels this week for Sunday availability.
items.implication: GTD; Tre Harris primary beneficiary if out

items.text: ETR W2 waivers injury beneficiaries: Ladd McConkey=Tre Harris; Ja'Kobi Lane=Bateman; Alvin Kamara=Kendre Miller; Dylan Sampson=Raheim Sanders; plus Flowers/McConkey watch.
Kenneth Walker handled 29 of first 32 RB opportunities for KC, 19 routes on 33 dropbacks, 6 targets (22% share), 23-173-1 rush + 3-18-1 rec. True workhorse as expected.
items.why: Dominated early opportunities and routes/targets in debut
items.opportunity: Nearly all RB snaps/opps, high route/target share

items.text: Ashton Jeanty 99 Utilization Score (tied Bijan), 73% snaps, 70% rushes, 61% routes, 21% targets, 23 carries +6 targets, 156 yds +2 TDs. Upgrades to high-end RB1 every-down.
items.why: Elite utilization and efficiency behind improved OL

items.text: Bucky Irving 62% snaps, 58% routes (out-routed Gainwell), 53% rushes, short-yardage lead, 85 Util Score. Upgrades to mid-range RB2; Gainwell mid-RB4.
items.why: Clear lead over Gainwell in snaps/routes/carries despite game script

items.text: Travis Etienne only 58% snaps/43% attempts/38% routes in 3-way committee even with Kamara out. Downgrades to low-end RB2; check next week.
items.why: Shared work heavily despite Kamara absence

items.text: Lions extremely concentrated: Gibbs, Amon-Ra St. Brown, LaPorta, Jameson Williams accounted for 65 of 70 offensive opportunities (93%). No RB2/WR3/TE2 usage.
items.implication: Start core with extreme confidence; avoid peripherals

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers hamstring not considered serious, day-to-day. Would have returned if playoff game; MRI pending.
items.why: Mild hamstring, abundance of caution exit
items.implication: Likely plays W2 or limited; Bateman/Andrews upside if sits

items.text: Rashee Rice career aDOT 4.9, last night 2.5; only 2 targets (7% share) but 29 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks (behind only Worthy). Needs volume to produce.
items.why: Routes present but short aDOT and low targets limit upside without volume

items.text: David Montgomery 65% rushes, all inside-5, 58% short-yardage despite 50-50 reports; Woody Marks two-minute. Upgrades high-end RB2.
Quinshon Judkins only 13 routes on 30 Watson dropbacks. Even after Dylan Sampson (knee) exited early, Browns used third-stringer Raheim Sanders for 13 routes.
items.implication: Pass-game limited; more of a pure runner

items.text: Malik Nabers first game post-ACL/meniscus: 52% snaps, 71% routes, 9 targets (31% share), 6-69-0. Emerged healthy.
items.opportunity: High target share on limited snaps
